# The Origin of the Work of Art

*[Martin Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) · 1950 · *Der Ursprung des Kunstwerkes**

Lectures written in 1935-1936 and published in 1950 in Off the Beaten Track. Against aesthetics, [Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) makes the work a "setting-into-work of truth": a Greek temple, a pair of shoes painted by Van Gogh open up a world and let the earth appear.
